thread:
maria: morning — quick async handoff. TL;DR: overall SLOs holding but saw a short tail-latency spike on /generate around 03:10 UTC. I kicked a small canary last night for a cache eviction tweak; need to follow up on alert noise. What I did: validated canary logs, ran a region synthetic, updated the canary config. Blockers: need an agreement on alert debounce window for low-impact spikes. Today: roll debounce to staging, run multi-region synthetic, and review devon's PR for circuit-breaker fallback.

sam: saw the same blip. looks like P95 stayed fine but P99 jumped ~600ms for ~2m. is that coming from cold KV misses or an L2 cache pressure?

lee: quick metric I pulled (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/generate\"}[2m])) by (le))
```
this shows the spike correlates with a small burst of evictions on cache_p99_evictions_total. link: https://dash.redwood/s/eng-sre/generate-latency

maria: thx lee. my read is a short eviction cascade after nightly aux-sync. we should probably avoid aggressive evicting during the aux-sync window.

devon: oncall notes — pager fired 2x for request-rate > 3x baseline but both were recovered automatically. i left a note on the incident: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-123 (resolved). i did triage: no backend errors, just latency. i've got a draft debounce rule here: `alert:RequestRateNoise` -> for noise_window: 120s, repeat: 3. pinging for quick signoff.

maria: can you paste the rule here? small prefer to run it in staging for 24h before prod. if it suppresses real regressions we need a fallback.

devon: rule snippet:
```
- alert: RequestRateNoise
  expr: increase(request_total[2m]) > (avg_over_time(request_total[1h]) * 3)
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
won't suppress sustained _error_ spikes, only short bursts. i'll add a maintainer tag.

sam: fyi i have a small infra PR to add a circuit-breaker on the client side to fast-fail when backend latency > 1s for retries. reviewers: @devon @maria. link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/482

lee: small warmup command if we need to mitigate cold misses quickly:
```
kubectl exec -c prim-cache $(kubectl get pod -l app=cache -o name | head -n1) -- /opt/bin/cache-warm --prefix /generate --parallel 8
```
use with caution during high traffic.

pagerbot: Pager resolved: INC-2026-123 auto-recovered (duration ~3m) — oncall: devon. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

maria: ok — plan: 1) run devon's debounce rule in staging (24h), 2) run multi-region synthetic (sam & me), 3) merge circuit-breaker PR after small perf test (devon), 4) add a short runbook note about aux-sync windows to avoid evict cascades (lee). I'll ping infra for automation to schedule aux-sync in low-traffic window.

devon: sounds good, i'll post the staging rollout timeline and tag reviewers.

sam: +1. i'll schedule synthetic at 10:00 PST and share results here.

maria: thanks all — if anything urgent ping @devon or @sam. leaving a quick checklist in the runbook: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/slo-handovers. :rocket:
